label: Both hands shoved into a friend: palms slapping a coat, the breath knocked out, a stumble
how: Two palms slapping a heavy coat a few hundredths apart (the packs' cloth), the dull weight of a body taking it under them (a soft thud, no flesh: nobody's hurt), the breath going out of whoever was shoved (a short open exhale, modelled), and a beat later their boot scuffing back across the boards as they catch themselves. Three shoves, each a little harder.
